steps.en: Install the prerequisites, clone and launch locally
steps.zh: 安装前置依赖，克隆并本地启动

steps.en: Paste links, select MP4 or MP3, and click Fetch
steps.zh: 粘贴链接，选 MP4 或 MP3，点击 Fetch

steps.en: Fetch titles, thumbnails and resolution choices
steps.zh: 获取标题、缩略图和清晰度选项

steps.en: Choose a resolution and click Download
steps.zh: 选择清晰度并点击 Download

steps.en: Download and merge or extract audio, then deliver the file to the browser
steps.zh: 下载并合并或提取音频，再把文件交给浏览器

value.en: Save clips through a visual picker without writing downloader flags for each URL
value.zh: 通过可视选择保存片段，无需为每条链接编写下载参数
